authority.provider: Ministry of Digital Affairs, Taiwan, CNS11643 Chinese Standard Interchange Code Full Character Database

visual_copybook.usage: rasterized visual topology comparison only; no outline, coordinate, or trace enters the image-generated glyph

policy.pass_definition: The exact requested scalar is present, its visible Taiwan Traditional topology agrees with the current CNS mapping and stroke-sequence structure, it remains directly recognizable at native, 128, 64, and 32 px cell sizes, the ink is isolated from the grid, and no stray thorn or topology-changing defect is visible.
policy.reject_definition: Any uncertain identity, simplified substitution, missing or extra semantic component, topology-changing join, unreadability at a reviewed size, grid contact, stray ink, or thorn-like defect.
policy.raster_limit: A final raster can establish visible topology but cannot prove the temporal act of writing each stroke.
policy.vectorization_limit: PASS permits controlled tracing of the isolated dark ink only. Grid lines, near-white background variation, antialias halos, and CNS copybook outlines are forbidden geometry.
policy.descriptor_mutation: This audit does not change source descriptors or mark any source as approved.

views: generated cell beside an independently rasterized CNS TW-Kai copybook
method.grid_detection: Exactly five long light-gray line groups per axis were detected by projection; the reported grid clearance is the minimum distance from a pixel darker than L=100 to the nearest detected cell boundary.
method.dark_component_check: Every raw cell was checked with 8-connected components at L<100; no isolated dark component smaller than 10 px was present.
method.background_note: The paper is visually clean but not numerically flat #FFFFFF. Pixels at L>=245 have standard deviation 1.20 to 1.35 across the four sheets, so background normalization is mandatory before tracing.
